main_text.p: tius mundi fore [?], aut esse debere supremum domi-num. Oratoria sanctorum Georgij, Cæciliæ & Sy-ri abbatis condidit: ac uestes auro & gemmis di-stinctas primus in sacrum usum dedit. Bibliothe-cam beati Petri restituit, & Ecclesijs uestigalia, quibus oleum (aliud idololatriæ genus) pro lam-padibus emeretur: & fundos assignauit, unde uiu-uerent [?]. Sacerdotalem habitum adimuenit: & Orien-talem Ecclesiam ab Occidentali seiunxit. Quat-tuor dialogorum libros, à Gregorio primo conscrip-tos, è Latino Græcus in Græcum transtulit; ut contra liberam Christi gratiam, & Græci purga-torium papisticum crederent. Bonifacium An-glum, Maguntinensem archiepiscopum per suas li-teras, episcopatus in Germania fundare permisit: & presbyterorum ordinationem, ad 25. ætatis an-num à tricesimo reduxit. Aunculi mortui uxorem ducere, quamuis à Gregorio tertio permissum, ini-quum declarauit: atq; ut compatres & commatres nullatenus in nuptijs se iungerent, constituit. Magni Gregorij corpus à Laterano ad Velum aureum sui nominis templum transtulit: & epitaphi-um Græcis literis exaratum illius tumulo addidit. Cassinensi cœnobio priuilegia multa contulit: ac Venetis mercatoribus, sub maledictionis pœna prohibuit, (& hoc Christiane quidem) ne lucri cau-sa Chri-

page.notes: Running head and page number read from the scan; "85" is doubtful, the numeral is partly obscured. "tius" and "fore" at the start of the page are doubtful. The word broken at "uiu-" / "uerent" is printed in a form I could not resolve with certainty; the hyphen and the line-end letters are as I read them. "ꝟc" before "uestes" read as "ac". Catchword "sa Chri-" at the foot, read as "sa Chri-"; the final hyphen is doubtful. Printing errors left as they are. The page is one continuous paragraph: no indented line appears.
